---
title: "The BENQODHI Workshop"
subtitle: "Expert workshop on quantum computing and optimization for life sciences and health"
---

## When and where

**10–11 September 2026 · JRC Ispra, Italy**

Day 1 takes place in Building 27B, Day 2 in Building 36. A social programme (aperitivo
and dinner) is planned for the evening of Day 1.

## What the workshop does

BENQODHI convenes experts in quantum computing, optimisation, AI, biology and health to
define credible, open benchmarks for transparent comparison across quantum, hybrid, AI,
and classical approaches.

The two days are structured around four themes:

- **Foundations & use cases** (Day 1) — invited talks covering benchmarking practice
  and concrete use cases from bioinformatics, genomics and health.
- **Benchmark design** (Day 2 morning) — parallel working tables turning Day 1's
  exchanges into concrete candidate benchmark problems.
- **JRC quantum laboratories** (Day 2 midday) — a guided visit.
- **European strategy** (Day 2 afternoon) — a policy session connecting the technical
  work to European decisions on quantum and hybrid computing for health and biology.

See the [program page](program.qmd) for the detailed timing and the
[speakers page](speakers.qmd) for who is contributing.

## Target outputs

- Three focused candidate benchmark dossiers.
- One shared framework note covering instances, baselines, metrics, resource
  accounting, reporting and repository needs.
- A named owner for every follow-up.

## Invited speakers and institutional contributors

Professors and researchers from Sapienza University of Rome, Leiden University, IBM
Research Europe (Zurich), ICREA and Universitat Pompeu Fabra, SISSA, PacBio, IRCCS
Ospedale San Raffaele, Barcelona Supercomputing Centre, CINECA and the University of
Cagliari.

Representatives from DG CNECT, DG SANTE, DG DEFIS and the EuroHPC Joint Undertaking are
also invited to contribute.
